versions.changelog:
douyin-public-data-fetcher-guaikei 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides command-line tools to search Douyin (TikTok China) videos, posts, comments, and real-time trending topics for content research and competitor analysis.
- Offers strict command-to-intent mapping and robust parameter inference from user queries.
- Supports only public Douyin data; does not handle posting, editing, or watermark removal.
- Enforces secure token handling via environment variables, with clear non-marketing error outputs on invalid tokens.
- Outputs results in pure JSON for easy integration; logs and error messages are cleanly separated.
